class.name: RosRequest
class.brief_description: A handle for an asynchronous ROS 2 service request.
class.description: [RosRequest] is returned by [method RosClient.async_send_request]. it acts as a promise or future, allowing you to check if a response has been received or await its completion.

method.name: get_response
method.description: Returns the response message received from the service. Returns [code]null[/code] if the request is not yet completed.

method.name: is_completed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the service response has been received.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted when the service response is received. The [param response] message is passed as an argument.
